mu.definition: Constitutive coefficient relating magnetic flux density and magnetic field strength in a linear medium.

rho.aliases: density; fluid density; material density; wall density

rho.aliases: resistivity; specific electrical resistance; rho notation for electrical resistivity; ρ notation for electrical resistivity

rho.definition: Kinetic pressure scale commonly defined as one half rho U squared.

eta.aliases: resistivity; specific electrical resistance; rho notation for electrical resistivity; ρ notation for electrical resistivity

The problem explicitly states η is the electrical resistivity of the fluid (resistance to electric current per unit length).
